source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The MV2 test disables the old extension-page injection preference and supplies broad host permission before expecting tabs.executeScript to reject on its own moz-extension page. It covers extension tab, popup and mail-tab update creation paths, then checks unchanged DOM fields. This separates the deprecated-target restriction from a simple absence of ordinary host permission in the fixture. Repeated identical file calls do not add another option case. The test does not cover CSS rejection or prove native behavior without execution.
title: Deprecated extension-page injection is tested with broad hosts and its compatibility preference disabled
